notes_for_human:
COOLING-OFF IS THE HEADLINE FINDING AND IT IS FRAGILE. The folklore 12-24 month number is only PARTIALLY supported by Bain's own words. Exactly one Bain-owned page yielded a numeric reapplication sentence, and it lives on a legacy path (/careers-old/recruiting/bfls/sea-recruiting/) written for Southeast Asia: 'Yes, you may re-apply but we will ask that you refrain from doing so until at least 12 months has passed, in line with our global approach to recruiting.' The current global careers site, every 2027-cycle program page, and the ACI hiring-process page are SILENT on reapplication. There is no Bain statement anywhere I could reach about retaking an online assessment. Do not publish '12 months' as a current global Bain policy on the strength of a legacy regional page — publish the quote with its legacy URL clearly attached, or hold the row.

METHOD CAVEAT, READ BEFORE PUBLISHING: every quote here was captured by automated text extraction of the live page on 2026-07-29, not by human eyes on the rendered page. Three quotes should be spot-checked by hand because they came back without terminal punctuation and may be truncated: the ACI compensation line ($9,000 monthly base), and the CREW class_year line. Any quote you cannot re-verify character-for-character should be dropped, not repaired.

DELIBERATE OMISSIONS. The ACI page extraction also returned a line reading 'Must be on track to graduate by June 2028 (if applicable for your office)'. That is exactly the kind of hard eligibility gate students act on, and it is NOT recorded as a quote above because I could not confirm it belongs to the program page rather than an embedded job-posting module. Verify it directly before adding it. Similarly, First Forward's sophomore + first-generation + winter 2027/spring 2028 graduation criteria are real but came back as fragments only.

SPONSORSHIP IS UNIFORMLY SILENT. Not one of the six program pages mentions visa sponsorship or work authorization. Per rule 5 that is a fact about the public record only. Sponsorship terms for Bain internships are almost certainly stated inside individual ATS postings, which were expired at time of check; re-check when the 2027 requisitions open.

PROGRAMS NOT YET CHECKED. Bain's internships hub (https://www.bain.com/careers/work-with-us/internships-programs/) lists roughly 33 programs. Undergraduate-relevant ones I did NOT open, and which likely carry their own class-year gates, include: ADvantage (US/Toronto), Building and Supporting Excellence / BASE (US), ExperienceBain, Bainworks, Jumpstart, Lead to Inspire Weekend, Lead to Inspire Masterclass, Lead to Inspire Fellowship, Power of 4, Belong@Bain, BainConnect, Build at Bain: Agentic AI in Practice (South America), the several True North Scholarships (London, Germany/Austria, Switzerland, Australia, India), Be Bold Scholarship, First Nations Scholarship (Australia), and Associate Consultant Trainee (Seoul). Budget a second pass for these.

CYCLE TIMING. As of 2026-07-29, BEL and CREW both point forward to a 2027 program with no criteria published yet; Consulting Kickstart still points only to 2026 and looks stale; First Forward shows closed with no next cycle named. For the 2027 undergraduate cycle, the eligibility rows above are carried over from the most recently published cycle, NOT confirmed 2027 criteria. Label them as such in the public database.
